text: OperationDescriptor is now the sole id/version/schema tuple in remote-exec-kernel; typed OperationRef wraps it. Sojourn SiteOperation carries codecs/retry, OperationRegistry.Entry carries the implementation, byte lowering has no casts, typedEntry and WorkerBridge.operationRef are removed, and catalogs/entries are sorted deterministically. Added migration notes and registry tests for ordering, duplicates/schema drift, raised errors, codec failures, and worker derivation. Focused evidence: Sojourn registry 4/4, local TCK 25/25, DSL 9/9; kernel 14/14, protocol 23/23, worker 29/29.
